pages.text: Equip in slot 7 to enable Cluckles logistics.
Equip in module slot 7. A tamed, owned Cluckles that is not sitting can process loaded containers within 64 blocks of its owner. Configurable search radius: 8, 16, 24 or 32 blocks.

Outbound sorting transfers repository items to containers already holding an identical item and with available capacity. The scan runs every 40 ticks and checks a bounded set of positions without loading chunks.
